ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the title of the attached figure is “Rainfall and Biomass 2005–2011”. The horizontal axis is the years 2005 to 2011; the left vertical axis is rainfall, with the unit being inches; the right vertical axis is biomass. The legend shows: the solid line represents producers, the dotted line represents primary consumers, and the gray dashed line represents rainfall. In the figure, the rainfall dashed line reaches its highest around 2006, close to 120 inches; near the same year, the reading of the dotted line for primary consumers on the right biomass axis is about around 150. Then reason: the question asks to infer the biomass range of primary consumers when rainfall is 120 inches. According to the year closest to 120 inches of rainfall in the figure, that is, near the peak value, read the biomass of the dotted line for primary consumers, about 150, so the appropriate range should be selected as 150 to 200.
